text:
:= by
  refine Archimedean.mk (λ x y : α, _) (λ x y h, _)
  · intro x y
    cases' x with x
    · exact zero_lt_one
    · cases' y with y
      · exact zero_lt_one
      · rw [lt_zero_iff_neg, neg_neg]
        exact le_rfl
  · intro x y h
    rcases h with ⟨n, h⟩
    exact (le_trans (le_add_right (zero_le x)) (add_le_add_left h (one_lt_one_add_one))).trans (le_refl x)
